why: A (no universes) is pure arithmetic on integers a_1..a_m: (i) for odd positive a, spectralIndex(oSpectrum a) = bottIndexO a, where oSpectrum a is a list of reals (π²(a_i+a_j)²/4 for i<j, π²(a_i−a_j)²/4 for a_i>a_j, each twice) that only its docstring calls the spectrum of K_{πA}, and spectralIndex counts conjugate parameters per Theorem 20.5 by definition; (ii) bottIndexO a = 0 when all a_j = 1; (iii) bottIndexO a ≥ 2m−2 for odd positive a not all 1. Vocabulary: B's λ formula equals bottIndexO (lamFormula_eq_bottIndexO, proved). B is geometric: (1) every non-minimal geodesic I → −I of O(2m) (induced metric) has Milnor index idxIn ≥ 2m−2; (2) the eigenspace dimensions of K_A = ¼[[A,W],A] on 𝔬(2m) are 2·#(a_i+a_j)²/4 + 2·#(a_i−a_j)²/4; (3) t ↦ exp(πtA) is a geodesic I → −I with idxIn = λ. A ⇒ B fails genuinely: it needs the K_A eigen-decomposition, Theorem 20.5 and the Index Theorem for O(2m) with the blind idxIn, and for (1) the reduction of an arbitrary geodesic I → −I to the normal form with odd a_j — none is in A (the project never ties oSpectrum or bottIndexO to an actual geodesic). B ⇒ A only vacuously (A re-proved outright from the project's counting lemmas); B has no spectralIndex, and deriving (iii) from B (1)+(3) would need non-minimality of exp(πtA) when some a_j ≥ 3.
overlap: B_to_A: 35 shared project theorems — the counting infrastructure of IndexCount.lean used by the item's proofs (spectralIndex_eq, two_mul_ncard_conjParams, ncard_conjParams_sq, conjParams_*, bottIndex_eq_sum_subtype, bottIndex_nonneg, bottIndex_term_nonneg, two_le_sub_of_odd, bottIndexO.eq_1 and simp auxiliaries); the item's theorems themselves avoided (the vacuous re-proof re-runs their proofs).
embedded_special_case_note: B is about concrete real matrices (Mathlib orthogonalGroup as a subset of M_n(ℝ), complex structures, Ω_k(n) as subsets; the induced-metric notions are already embedded); it does not quantify over abstract Riemannian manifolds.
